title: $50 Cash Westpac after Learning Modules / $50 New Westpac Customer @ Anyway
body:
Deal: $50 Cash Westpac after Learning Modules / $50 New Westpac Customer @ Anyway

[a1k] Thanks. Should've reminded people in the description to sign up to Anyway using the random referrals.
[lothus777] Thanks OP, took me 5 minutes.
Resets in two days for another $50
[Daabido] Don't you have to be 18 to open a Westpac Choice account?
[dchrono] Looks like they have options for teens , not sure if it needs parent account or not
[artcvan] Think they even allow under 14s now, it's just their overall name for their transaction account. Though you need to be over 14 to open online.
[Hvrd] I didn’t think you did, was just waiting for someone to say it
[JAF] Just did it with a referral code and the quizzes took maybe 5 minutes and withdrew to Westpac account … seemed a bit too easy and too good to be true though. Guess we wait and see if it actually gets deposited into our accounts.
[Merlict] Click the referall link below the post, do some lil quizzes, cash out. That easy.
[dchrono] Looks like you don't have to connect through StudentEdge at all and can go to Anyway directly (use referrals!). The Westpac additional offer is essentially their $50 cashback from opening a new account which has been available for a while now.
The questions are run of the mill multiple choice swipe right/left surface level stuff. It's marked 15 minutes per module but realistically it's way less than 5 minutes (unless you do want to "test-drive careers") and they allow redo if you make any mistakes.
Normal exchange rate is 100 coins > $1, with only a few courses being 100 coins per module while the rest are less, pretty easy free money though thanks OP!
[dchrono] Right below this post body text, above the share to social media buttons, click the "referral: random"
[Merlict] No idea what the business model is here? Can't see how they get even $4 of research / advertising from you doing a mindless little quiz, let alone $50!
[dchrono] I'm guessing some kind of marketing by the brands, maybe AI training even though the material are really basic, and possibly testing a UI/webpage system of sorts before applying it for other website, or data collection as per usual
[PotatoCakes] Encourages you to cash out via Westpac.
Maybe its the same reason theyre throwing all the money at shopback?
[actuarial] In the FAQ, it mentions 100 coins = $1. Is it actually $50?
Right now, eligible coins can be redeemed in Rewards at a rate of 100 coins for $1 AUD of GiftPay value.
[love me agooddeal] The $50 value is only eligible if cashed out to a Westpac account.
[Jayblesz] When you go to cashout it says 10x bonus. You can also read their FAQ about the Westpac promo
[Jayblesz] Nice one - thanks OP.
Let's see if it lands then do again on 01/08!
[zonta] only had 400coins now. And cant even reach 500. Any one the same?
[Hvrd] Go back to training page scroll down and do a random career module
[dchrono] can also click top left and click library for everything they have
[crackman] Unfortunately haven't been able to open a Westpac account. Apparently I'm already a customer..
[artcvan] Have you ever held an account at all with Westpac? You'll need to use your original customer ID and password to login, even if it's been years since you last had a Westpac account. You are considered an "existing" customer, but will still be eligible for deals, provided you haven't held certain account types within a specified timeframe (ie should be 2 years for the Double You bonus)
[spaz84] seemed too good to be true… thought it might be a scam.
However, student edge has the details op mentioned
https://studentedge.org/au/deals/details/anyway-westpac-rewa…
[Ash-Say] It was easy - hopefully $50 comes through
